response.courseDescription: 161 Nuclear Reactor Operations I Foundational topics in reactor operations at the WSU TRIGA 1 MW nuclear research reactor, including nuclear theory, nuclear physics, radiation safety, health physics, reactor physics reactor kinetics, neutron transport theory, reactor auxiliary systems, and federal regulations. Cooperative: Open to UI degree-seeking students.
response.coursePrerequisites: CHEM 101 or 105 or concurrent enrollment in either.
